channel.title: K C B Inc - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from K C B Inc (kcbs.com)

item.title: Havana Syndrome in Vietnam: Possible Russian role in attack on Americans, according to new evidence
item.description: Eleven U.S. officials were injured in a Havana Syndrome-style attack ahead of VP Kamala Harris's 2021 trip to Hanoi. A newly discovered document suggests Russia may have been involved.

item.title: The youngest victims of "Havana Syndrome"
item.description: Officials and diplomats are not the only ones who have reported unexplained symptoms at home and abroad. Strange illnesses and injuries have also impacted some of their children.

item.title: One Question | Meet the top candidates for California governor
item.description: Julie Watts interviewed every candidate for California governor ahead of next year's election.

item.title: 5-year Havana Syndrome investigation finds evidence of who might be responsible
item.description: 60 Minutes producers Michael Rey and Oriana Zill de Granados discuss the evolution of their 5-year investigation into Havana Syndrome, which led them to what one source calls "a receipt" for acoustic weapon testing done by a Russian intelligence unit.

item.title: 3/5: CBS Evening News
item.description: Noem's testimony about $220 million ad campaign may have been final straw for Trump; Dog tracks down missing 13-year-old boy with autism

item.title: Pentagon formally designates Anthropic a supply chain risk amid feud over AI guardrails
item.description: The U.S. military has formally designated artificial intelligence firm Anthropic a supply chain risk, a sweeping move that could cut it off from military contracts.

item.title: Bernard LaFayette, Selma voting rights organizer, dies at 85
item.description: Bernard LaFayette, the advance man who did the risky groundwork for the voter registration campaign in Selma, Alabama, that culminated in the passage of the Voting Rights Act of 1965, has died.

item.title: Rep. Tony Gonzales drops out of House runoff race after admitting affair with aide
item.description: GOP Rep. Tony Gonzales had been in a runoff with Brandon Herrera after Tuesday's primary in Texas.

item.title: 3/5: The Takeout with Major Garrett
item.description: President Trump ousts Kristi Noem as DHS Secretary; Trump picks Sen. Mullin (R-OK) to replace Noem

item.title: Trump says he must have a role in choosing Iran's next leader as war expands
item.description: President Trump said he must have a role in choosing Iran's next leader and called the son of the late Ayatollah Ali Khamenei "unacceptable."
